name: Furniture reupholstery and repair

google_prefill.phone: [G] the listed phone (stays the business's; customers use Rosie's one number)

A.flow: A: the customer comes to the business (video or phone count as A)

services.name: Seat re-cover
services.story: The main story: a dining chair seat re-covered with Alex's own fabric, $35 from the shop's board. Nothing is taken: a YES books the drop-off. Walt texts READY, and Alex pays at the counter at pick-up.

services.name: Armchair re-cover
services.story: A wingback chair, priced at the counter after a look. Nothing is taken. Walt's written price is OK'd before any work, and Alex pays at the counter at pick-up.

services.name: Dining chairs, set of 4
services.story: Four dining chairs re-covered, $140 labor. A $40 deposit orders the fabric, and the $100 rest is paid at the counter at pick-up.

B.flow: B: the business goes to the customer
B.staff: Abel and Rhea (upholsterers who make house calls)

services.name: Armchair re-cover
services.story: The main story: a house call for an armchair and a footstool. Only the $89 estimate visit is promised, with a card saved for it. Abel prices each item at the visit. The pieces come back Thu Nov 12, and Rosie texts the bill.

services.name: Dining chair seats, set of 4
services.story: Four dining chair seats, $179, picked up, re-covered at the shop and delivered back. A card is saved for the $89 fee. Rosie texts the bill after delivery.

services.name: Sofa reupholstery
services.story: A sofa reupholstery, priced from photos at $640. Sam OKs it. A $160 deposit orders the fabric, and the $480 rest is on the bill after delivery.

questions_before_times: What needs doing: new fabric, new foam, springs, a frame repair, or other
The piece: a dining chair, an armchair, a sofa, a cushion, an ottoman
The date it is needed by, like a holiday dinner
Fabric: the customer's own, or one from the shop's books
For a sofa or large piece: photos from the front, the back and underneath
license: none for upholstery or furniture repair in most places; the business registration; some states ask a separate registration to make, repair or renovate stuffed or upholstered goods (a generic switch, filled from the state form)
